name: Crawl4AI
description: Crawls and scrapes web pages into clean Markdown for RAG pipelines, with CSS, XPath, and LLM-driven structured extraction, deep crawling, and full browser session control.

skills.name: LLM Ready Markdown
skills.description: Generates clean Markdown with heuristic and BM25 noise filtering, numbered citation references for links, and pluggable strategies.

skills.name: Structured Data Extraction
skills.description: Extracts JSON matching a user-defined schema using CSS or XPath selectors, or delegates to an LLM for semantic field extraction.

skills.name: Deep Site Crawling
skills.description: Traverses whole sites with BFS and best-first strategies under page limits, using prefetch URL discovery and resumable crash recovery.

skills.name: Browser Session Control
skills.description: Drives Chromium, Firefox, or WebKit with persistent profiles, proxies, stealth mode, hooks, and reusable sessions for multi-step crawls.

skills.name: Docker API Server
skills.description: Exposes a FastAPI /crawl endpoint with JWT authentication plus MCP integration so agent clients can crawl over HTTP.
